q: The Asymptotic Equipartition Property (AEP) for i.i.d. X₁,X₂,… with entropy H says:
opts: The number of likely sequences is n·H
exp: AEP (Shannon-McMillan): -(1/n)log p(X₁,…,Xₙ) → H(X) in probability. There are ≈2^{nH} typical sequences each with probability ≈2^{-nH}. This justifies lossless compression at rate H and is the foundation of source coding theory.
